code.text: COAG

text.div:
Annotation

Conclusion and Recommendations based on this report and previous findings known to us:
The patient shows hypoxemia, mild anemia, leukopenia, thrombocytopenia, elevated ferritin, LDH, D-dimer, CRP, and creatinine, with low glucose and protein. These findings suggest systemic inflammation, possible infection, and impaired oxygenation, with evidence of mild renal dysfunction and coagulopathy. Clinical correlation is recommended to rule out severe infection (e.g., sepsis), hypoxic injury, or hematologic disorder. Immediate clinical evaluation is advised.
